p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full, nonzero separator divides two equal-sized panels.
    for r in range(h):
        if w and len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0 and r == h // 2:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if len(top) == len(bottom) and top:
                return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                        for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0 and c == w // 2:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            if all(len(a) == len(b) for a, b in zip(left, right)) and left and left[0]:
                return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                        for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
    raise ValueError("No centered separator dividing equal panels")
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p, p.read_text())
